# University of Colorado

> The University of Colorado system provides unified access to student and employee portals, academic resources, and institutional services across five campuses.

cu.edu serves as the central hub for the University of Colorado system, which includes CU Boulder, CU Denver, UCCS, CU Anschutz, and the CU System Office. The site facilitates authentication, campus access, and institutional communication for students, faculty, and staff across all campuses.
